properties.description:
The Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection has issued a
Code ORANGE Air Quality Alert for the Susquehanna Valley today into
tonight. The periods of worst air quality will be this morning and
again after sunset this evening.

A Code ORANGE Air Quality Alert means that air pollution
concentrations within the region may become unhealthy for sensitive
groups. Sensitive groups include children, people suffering from
asthma, heart disease or other lung diseases, and the elderly. The
effects of air pollution can be minimized by avoiding strenuous
activity or exercise outdoors.

For more information on ground-level fine particles, visit
www.airnow.gov, and www.aqpartners.state.pa.us.

properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Flagler County in northeastern Florida...

* WHEN...Until 1145 AM EST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways. Ponding of water in urban or other areas is
occurring or is imminent.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 837 AM EST, Doppler radar indicated moderate to heavy rainfall
traversing much of Flagler County from east to west. Minor
flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly in the advisory
area. Between 3 and 7 inches of rain have fallen this week.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected over
the area this morning. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Palm Coast, Flagler Beach, Bunnell, Andalusia, Marineland,
Beverly Beach and Espanola.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

deaths occur in vehicles.

enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.
